A1.justification: Both complete 20-page PDFs describe the same SpiritSight work and include Appendices A–G. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original SpiritSight benchmark results, ablations, a custom grounding evaluation, and human validation of collected data.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark, ablation, grounding, and data-validation results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The InternVL2-based architecture, GUI-Lasagne training pipeline, UBP procedure, and 2D block-wise position embeddings remain unchanged, including the appendix architecture and training templates.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training sources, six benchmarks, English/Chinese transfer scenarios, and custom text2bbox evaluation. The dataset-availability statement adds no training or evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–3 and Figure 6a. Table 1 retains the same methods, including SeeClick, CogAgent, and OmniParser.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix D retain the same model sizes, preprocessing, training schedules, evaluation metrics, and sample counts. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The UBP, dataset-level, CoT, scaling, and language-transfer analyses remain identical, as do the appendix grounding examples and data-quality validation studies.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the appendix human evaluations. No seed, repeated-run, confidence-interval, or significance-test information is added or removed.

E6.justification: All matched numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains SpiritSight-8B's 52.7% cross-task Step SR, and Appendix D.4 retains the 96.1% custom grounding hit rate.

T1.justification: The UBP coordinate definitions and derivation in Equations 1–6 and the policy decomposition in Appendix B, Equations 7–10, are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and performance claims concerning GUI-Lasagne, UBP, and SpiritSight's cross-platform navigation capabilities.

C2.justification: Section 6's interpretations, Section 7's privacy/security limitation, and Appendix E.3's discussion of data-cleaning errors remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the direct Hugging Face model-repository link with a project-page link and changes 'Models are available' to 'Models and datasets are available.' This expands documented resource access; implementation details remain unchanged. The PDFs do not verify the linked resources.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A, and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. Changed reference back-links reflect text reflow rather than citation additions or removals.

P1.justification: The abstract's resource-access sentence and arXiv version/date stamp change. The remaining prose and section/appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: The opening pages have limited text reflow, with corresponding reference back-link updates. Figure assets and table displays remain unchanged, and all appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: The revised abstract explicitly directs readers to datasets as well as models, modestly improving information about resource access. Scientific content and evidence are unchanged. Since the PDFs cannot establish the linked resources' accessibility or completeness, the supported improvement is limited to documentation.
